title: POST /v1/enroll response
description: What the server returns once. Nothing sink-shaped travels here: the destination arrives later in the served config, and the write scope is enforced per authorization. The client decodes this strictly -- an unknown field fails the enrollment.

organization.description: The org slug, server-assigned from the presented claim rather than client-chosen: an install cannot place itself in another org's subtree. Becomes the organization= segment of every object key.
